title: 1953 AHSME Problem 39
statement: The product, \(\log_a b\cdot\log_b a\) is equal to:

solutions.text:
For permissible bases and arguments, \[ \begin{aligned} \log_a b\cdot\log_b a &=\frac{\log b}{\log a}\\ &\quad{}\cdot\frac{\log a}{\log b}\\ &=1. \end{aligned} \]

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Use the change-of-base formula on both logarithms
The two resulting fractions are reciprocals
